name: 30-convert-claude-messages-image-migration-tail
description: The second half of the image migration at :315-333: an assistant turn is the *last* message and carries the only image, so the forward scan for a user turn runs off the end (`j === messages.length`). The reference then splices a fresh `{role: 'user', content: []}` in at `i + 1` (:327) and appends the images to `messages[j]` -- which is the message it just inserted. The assistant turn is left with a text part only, and the new user turn is the last turn of the result. This branch is the one a port is most likely to get wrong by re-scanning after the insert.
